title: AI-assisted preparation prompts
body: Tool-agnostic prompts. AI drafts; a named human reviews facts, sharing, and capability claims before anything is used or sent.

lines.label: Authorized inputs
lines.text: Workbook formulas, assumption register, metric cards, costs and evidence.

lines.label: Prompt
lines.text: Audit units, periods, adoption/population, event frequency, raw burden versus measured saving, efficiency, coverage, recapture, risk and cost scope. Identify overlapping benefits and repeated discounts. Reproduce no new customer facts. Explain downside/base/upside and distinguish capacity, hard-dollar and directional value. Flag source-methodology conflicts.

lines.label: Required output
lines.text: QA findings with cell/assumption IDs, severity, correction and owner.

lines.label: Human review
lines.text: Human value reviewer verifies arithmetic and business interpretation.
